api.name: CamelContext
api.title: Camel Context
api.description: The runtime that owns the routes, the registry, the components and the templates; from exchange.getContext() or injected. Create a ProducerTemplate, FluentProducerTemplate or ConsumerTemplate once (a field, reused) and never per exchange. getVariable(name) is the global variable repository, exchange.getVariable(name) the exchange's. getEndpoint(uri) creates the endpoint when it is not yet known, hasEndpoint(uri) only looks. getRoute(id) is null when the route is unknown.

createConsumerTemplate.description: Creates a ConsumerTemplate to poll an endpoint on demand: receiveBody(uri, timeout, type); create once and reuse.

createFluentProducerTemplate.description: Creates a FluentProducerTemplate: to(uri).withBody(body).withHeader(name, value).send() or .request(type); create once and reuse.

createProducerTemplate.description: Creates a ProducerTemplate to send to endpoints from code (sendBody, requestBody); create once and reuse, not per exchange.

signatures: <T extends Component> T getComponent(String name, Class<T> componentType)
Component getComponent(String name, boolean autoCreateComponents, boolean autoStart)
getComponent.description: A component by scheme, created when needed; getComponent(name, type) returns it typed.

signatures: Endpoint getEndpoint(String uri, Map<String, Object> parameters)
<T extends Endpoint> T getEndpoint(String name, Class<T> endpointType)
getEndpoint.description: The endpoint of a URI, created together with its component when not yet known; hasEndpoint(uri) only checks.

getGlobalOption.description: A global option by key (camel.main.globalOptions or getGlobalOptions()).

getPropertiesComponent.description: The application properties: resolveProperty(key) returns an Optional<String>.

getRegistry.description: The bean registry: lookupByName(name), lookupByNameAndType(name, type), findByType(type), bind(name, bean).

getRoute.description: The route with the id, null when unknown; getRoutes() lists them all.

getRouteController.description: Starts, stops, suspends and resumes routes by id: startRoute(id), stopRoute(id), getRouteStatus(id).

getRoutes.description: All routes: getRouteId(), getEndpoint() (the from), getRouteController() for their status.

getTypeConverter.description: Converts between types the way getBody(type) does: convertTo(type, value), mandatoryConvertTo, tryConvertTo.

getVariable.description: A global variable (the global repository); exchange.getVariable(name) is the exchange's own.

hasEndpoint.description: The endpoint of the URI when it already exists, else null.

resolveDataFormat.description: A data format by name (jackson, csv, xml-jackson) to marshal and unmarshal in code.

resolveLanguage.description: A language by name (simple, groovy, jsonpath) to build an Expression or Predicate in code: createExpression(text), createPredicate(text).

resolvePropertyPlaceholders.description: Replaces the {{key}} placeholders in the text with the property values.
